title: Film hero
description: Your video or photo fills the whole frame and opens like a gate; a large thin title arrives word by word on the empty side of it, with a small spaced label and a thin gold line. Give the face box (and the body box): the block picks the wider free side, sizes the type to that column and darkens only that strip, never the person. Without a face box the words sit in a band at the bottom. On a phone the picture goes on top, framed on the face.

props.src: required, video (mp4/webm) or photo that fills the frame
props.title: required, 3-8 words
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of the face in 0..1 of the picture
props.body: [x, y, w, h] of the whole person in 0..1 of the picture (guessed from the face when missing)
props.kicker: small spaced label above the title
props.sub: one line under the gold line
props.name: small spaced name under it
props.side: left or right: force the side of the words (default: the wider free side)
props.align: top (default: the title starts at the top of its column, the name sits at the foot), middle or bottom
props.poster: still shown before the video loads

example.title: The most beautiful way to learn AI
